# Heaven Funeral Services — Wayanad, Kerala

> Heaven Funeral Services is a 24-hour Christian funeral service provider in Wayanad district, Kerala, India, operating two shops: one at Payyampally in Mananthavady taluk (north Wayanad) and one at Chennalode in Vythiri taluk near Kalpetta (central and south Wayanad). It is a venture of the Woads Group. The business arranges Christian funerals, supplies coffins and processional crosses, rents mortuary freezer boxes, operates hearse vans for dead body transport, and coordinates long-distance journeys across Kerala, Karnataka, and Tamil Nadu.

Coordinates: 11.810803, 76.0536769.
Serves Mananthavady town, Panamaram, Kattikulam, Thirunelli, Vellamunda, Thalappuzha, and the northern panchayats.

### Chennalode shop — central and south Wayanad
Chennalode, Vythiri taluk, Wayanad, Kerala 673121, India.
Coordinates: 11.63045, 76.0867. Just north of Kalpetta, about 22km south of the Payyampally shop.
Serves Kalpetta, Vythiri, Meppadi, Muttil, Pozhuthana, and on towards Sulthan Bathery.

## Services

### Christian Funeral Arrangements
The core of the business. Coffins, processional crosses, candles, and floral arrangements, with timings coordinated directly with the parish priest, the church, and the cemetery. Families of every denomination are served, and families of other faiths just as readily.

### 24/7 Dead Body Transport
Round-the-clock dispatch from either shop to hospitals, homes, and mortuaries anywhere in Wayanad district. No wait for office hours.

### Hearse Van Service
Company-owned enclosed hearse vans carrying the departed from hospital or home to the church, temple, or burial ground. Transport is not subcontracted.

### Mortuary Freezer Box on Rent
Mobile dead body freezer boxes delivered to houses, parish halls, and hospitals across Wayanad. The unit is installed by the Heaven team and collected once the rites are complete.

### Coffins, Crosses and Flowers
A showroom range of coffins at both shops, from plain handcrafted wood through to decorated finishes, plus processional crosses, candles, and floral arrangements. Families may visit either shop to view them, or request photographs over WhatsApp.

### Church and Parish Coordination
Direct contact with the parish office and the cemetery so the body arrives when the service is ready to begin, and the family is not left chasing arrangements.

### Long Distance Dead Body Transport
Inter-district and inter-state journeys — Kannur, Kozhikode, Bengaluru, wider Karnataka, and Tamil Nadu — planned end to end, with the family kept updated en route.

### Handling and Documentation
Respectful handling plus the transfer paperwork and permits required for travel across district and state boundaries, arranged from pickup through arrival.

## Service areas

From the Payyampally shop (north Wayanad, Mananthavady taluk): Payyampally, Mananthavady, Thalappuzha, Korom, Vellamunda, Nalloornad, Anjukunnu, Valad, Panamaram, Kattikulam, Thirunelli, Thondernad, Edavaka, Tharuvana, Boys Town, Dwaraka, Tholpetty.

From the Chennalode shop (central and south Wayanad, Vythiri taluk): Chennalode, Kalpetta, Vythiri, Meppadi, Muttil, Pozhuthana, Padinjarathara, Kaniyambetta, Kottathara, Thariyode, Vengappally, Lakkidi, Pookode.

East Wayanad (Sulthan Bathery taluk): Sulthan Bathery, Meenangadi, Ambalavayal, Pulpally, Mullankolly, Nenmeni, Noolpuzha, Poothadi, Kidanganad.

Neighbouring districts and long distance: Iritty, Kelakam, Peravoor, Thalassery, Kannur, Kozhikode, Thamarassery, Coorg and Kutta in Karnataka, Gudalur in Tamil Nadu, Bengaluru and other cities.

## Common questions

**Where are the shops?** Two of them — Payyampally in Mananthavady taluk, and Chennalode in Vythiri taluk just north of Kalpetta. Between them they cover the whole district.

**Do you arrange Christian funerals?** Yes, that is the main work: coffins, processional crosses, candles, flowers, and coordination with the parish priest, church, and cemetery.

**Can a freezer box be arranged at short notice?** Yes. Mobile mortuary freezer boxes are delivered and set up anywhere in Wayanad; availability is confirmed on the phone.

**Is there a hearse van available?** Yes, company-owned enclosed hearse vehicles with temperature support.

**Do you travel outside Wayanad?** Yes — regularly into Kannur and Kozhikode, and on long-distance journeys to Karnataka and Tamil Nadu.

**Are you open at night?** Yes, 24 hours a day, every day including holidays.

**What does it cost?** Cost depends on distance, freezer rental duration, and coffin choice. A clear figure is given on the phone before anything is arranged, with nothing added afterwards.

## About

Heaven Funeral Services operates as a venture of the Woads Group. The business is run by a local team across its two Wayanad shops: the same people answer the dispatch line, prepare the vehicle, and remain present until arrangements are settled. Christian funeral arrangements are its main work, and it serves families, hospitals, care homes, and parishes across Wayanad without restriction by community or faith.
